task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Open emergency treasury: release silver and grain reserves to fund medical supplies, hire physicians, distribute food to quarantined households, and track mortality via local census returns
Deploy garrison troops to cordon infected wards, enforce travel restrictions between cities, escort medical convoys, and prevent riots at granaries and pharmacies
Rapidly convert existing buildings into isolation wards, repair water and sewage infrastructure, build temporary pest-houses, and ensure corpse disposal conforms to sanitary norms
